messages.subject: Project Cedar - SPA v3 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Our further mark-up attached. To bridge: we accept the 24-month general warranty notification period; in return the general warranty cap comes to 30% of consideration, and the de minimis returns to £25,000. The tax limitation stays at seven years. On that basis I think we're substantially there on liability. The two specific indemnities (Doyle; HMRC R&D) remain as drafted.

Grateful for confirmation so we can move to agreed form.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0834
